en_title: As GTA 6 Preload Goes Live, Fans Dig Into the Data to Try to Unearth Unannounced Information Ahead of Launch
cn_title: 《GTA6》预载开放之际，粉丝深入研究数据，试图在发售前挖掘未公布的信息
opus_summary: 《GTA6》已在新西兰开放预载，玩家正扫描加密游戏文件寻找新信息。据报道，音频文件占用22GB；玩家还发现了可能与线上模式、地区内容差异及PS5 Pro光线追踪支持有关的线索。Rockstar尚未公布各平台的分辨率和帧率详情。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 preloads are live for those who live in New Zealand (or are pretending to live in New Zealand to play early) and fans are scanning the game files for new information. Of course, the files are encrypted so they can only tell us so much.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》已向居住在新西兰的人（或假装居住在新西兰以提前游玩的人）开放预载，粉丝们正在扫描游戏文件，寻找新信息。当然，这些文件经过了加密，因此能告诉我们的信息有限。

paragraphs.en: The main takeaway is how much space each of the things in GTA 6 takes up. Rockstar has announced that GTA 6 weighs in at up to 212 GB, “depending on your device.” But following the release of the preload today, it was reported that the audio file alone is 22GB.
paragraphs.cn: 主要发现是《GTA6》中的各部分分别占用多少空间。Rockstar已宣布，《GTA6》最大体积为212 GB，「具体取决于你的设备」。但在今天开放预载后，有报道称，仅音频文件就有22GB。

paragraphs.en: Elsewhere, one Rockstar fan believes that because the files for story content are separated out from the main game files, the same will be true for the inevitable next version of GTA Online. This would suggest that you’ll eventually be able to install single-player and Online separately.
paragraphs.cn: 此外，一名Rockstar粉丝认为，由于剧情内容的文件与游戏主文件分开，不可避免会推出的下一版《GTA Online》也会如此。这意味着你最终可能可以分别安装单人模式和线上模式。

paragraphs.en: An account focused on reporting PlayStation game file sizes also noticed “intentType": "launchMultiplayerActivity," seemingly confirming Online’s eventual appearance in GTA 6. Rockstar has been completely silent on the existence of GTA Online for GTA 6, but the enduring success of GTA 5’s online portion means it’s safe to assume it’ll happen at some point.
paragraphs.cn: 一个专门报道PlayStation游戏文件大小的账号也注意到了「intentType「: 」launchMultiplayerActivity,」，这似乎证实了线上模式最终会出现在《GTA6》中。Rockstar对《GTA6》是否存在《GTA Online》一直完全保持沉默，但《GTA5》线上部分的持续成功意味着，可以有把握地认为它迟早会出现。

paragraphs.en: Interestingly, a file named "core_restofworld001" is missing from the Australia & New Zealand version of GTA 6, perhaps suggesting there's cut content in those regions. Another fan noticed that BVH8 will be supported in GTA 6. BVH8 specifically makes ray tracing work better on PS5 Pro, which Ubisoft used for Assassin’s Creed Shadow’s PS5 Pro support.
paragraphs.cn: 有趣的是，澳大利亚和新西兰版本的《GTA6》中缺少一个名为「core_restofworld001」的文件，这或许意味着这些地区的版本有内容被删减。另一名粉丝注意到，《GTA6》将支持BVH8。BVH8专门让光线追踪在PS5 Pro上运行得更好，育碧曾在《刺客信条：影》对PS5 Pro的支持中使用这一技术。

paragraphs.en: “By itself, the PS5 Pro's faster GPU helps performance without much effort from developers, but the game changing technology is the improved ray tracing capabilities of the PS5 Pro that BVH82 offers over BVH4,” Ubisoft said at the time. “With our implementation of BVH8 support on PS5 Pro, we were able to speed up GPU tasks involving hardware ray tracing usage by about 300%.”
paragraphs.cn: 育碧当时表示：「PS5 Pro速度更快的GPU本身就能在开发者不费太多力气的情况下提升性能，但带来变革的技术是BVH82相较于BVH4在PS5 Pro上提供的更强光线追踪能力。通过在PS5 Pro上实现对BVH8的支持，我们得以将涉及使用硬件光线追踪的GPU任务加速约300%。」

paragraphs.en: Officially, all we know about PS5 Pro support is the confirmation from Sony that GTA 6 will feature “PS5 Pro Enhanced Support.” Unfortunately, there’s been no word on what exactly that means. Indeed, Rockstar has yet to announce resolution and frame rate details for GTA 6 on any platform.
paragraphs.cn: 官方关于PS5 Pro支持的消息，我们只知道索尼已确认《GTA6》将提供「PS5 Pro增强支持」。遗憾的是，目前还没有关于这具体意味着什么的消息。事实上，Rockstar尚未公布《GTA6》在任何平台上的分辨率和帧率详情。

paragraphs.en: However, those hoping for higher frame rates might be disappointed. According to experts, it’s unlikely GTA 6 will go higher than 30fps on any platform because of its ray tracing and physics simulations.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，期待更高帧率的人可能会失望。据专家表示，由于光线追踪和物理模拟，《GTA6》在任何平台上的帧率都不太可能超过30fps。

paragraphs.en: While you wait for GTA 6’s November 19 launch, there’s still a small chance you might be able to bag some GTA 6 merch from Selfridges , but it’s selling out fast. And we've got all the information you need on the GTA 6 preload global release times , as well as details on the physical poster.
paragraphs.cn: 在等待《GTA6》于11月19日发售期间，你仍有一丝机会从Selfridges买到一些《GTA6》周边，但这些商品很快就要售罄了。我们还掌握了你需要了解的所有《GTA6》预载全球开放时间信息，以及实体海报的详情。
